class.name: harambe_ankle_ethercat_driver_v2/HarambeEthercatDriver
class.description: CSP/CST EtherCAT driver (v2) for the Harambe ankle. PRIMARY transform is the bicubic fit of the measured grid; the serial-chain method is published on /ankle_method_compare for comparison only. Command layout: position, effort, mode_of_operation. Inherits ethercat_driver/EthercatDriver.

class.name: harambe_ankle_ethercat_driver_v2/HarambePvtDriver
class.description: PVT (CiA 402 mode 5) EtherCAT driver (v2) for the Harambe ankle. PRIMARY transform is the bicubic fit; serial-chain published for comparison only. Command layout: position, velocity, effort, kp, kd (kp/kd per-motor passthrough). Shares the kinematics with the CSP/CST driver.
